Pinned upstream dependencies for g1_sonic_system1
==================================================

This project depends on three upstream repositories, vendored as git
submodules under third_party/ and pinned to the exact commits we used.
Only lerobot carries an in-repo source edit (captured as a patch under
patches/). Isaac-GR00T's changes are runtime monkeypatches inside our own
scripts/launch_sft.py; GR00T-WholeBodyControl is used unmodified.

Submodules (see .gitmodules; commit is the staged gitlink, shown below)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

1) third_party/Isaac-GR00T      (GR00T -- "GR00T N1.7" backbone)
   url    : https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T.git
   commit : 9c7e746b2cd37a810070a98ef41d290a07e806c2
   patch  : (none -- clean upstream tree; our changes are runtime
            monkeypatches in scripts/launch_sft.py, already committed)

2) third_party/lerobot          (ACT baseline policy + dataset tooling)
   url    : https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot.git
   commit : d4b3ca569cac25cf0ebf053dab9038bc040564f4
   patch  : patches/lerobot-act-discrete-head.patch
            (ACT discrete-FSQ classification-head surgery; touches
             src/lerobot/policies/act/configuration_act.py and
             src/lerobot/policies/act/modeling_act.py)
            The hands-in variant additionally applies the per-task
            hand-active-mask edit via scripts/bB_patch_act_hand_mask.py
            (anchor-based; run after the patch above).

3) third_party/GR00T-WholeBodyControl   (SONIC -- whole-body control deploy)
   url    : https://github.com/NVlabs/GR00T-WholeBodyControl.git
   commit : 60de0df7ffedeef415fe58d435e92cc5b01ba3d9
   patch  : (none -- used unmodified)
            NOTE: this upstream repo is ~5.9 GB (git-lfs meshes / ONNX /
            checkpoints). It is referenced as a submodule ONLY; its content
            is NOT vendored into this repo.

How to reproduce the exact environment
--------------------------------------
  # 1. Clone this repo WITH submodules (fetches the three pinned upstreams):
  git clone --recursive git@github.com:sagrawal0410/g1-system10.git
  cd g1-system10
  # (or, if already cloned:  git submodule update --init --recursive)

  # 2. Apply our lerobot source edit on top of the pinned checkout:
  git -C third_party/lerobot apply ../../patches/lerobot-act-discrete-head.patch
  #    (hands-in ACT only) then add the per-task hand loss mask:
  #    python scripts/bB_patch_act_hand_mask.py

  # 3. Isaac-GR00T needs no patch (runtime monkeypatch lives in scripts/launch_sft.py).
  # 4. GR00T-WholeBodyControl is used unmodified.

Note: the submodule gitlinks pin the exact commits above; if a
`git submodule update` cannot find a commit (e.g. upstream force-push /
history rewrite), fetch it explicitly:
  git -C third_party/<name> fetch origin <commit>
